contract: GET /api/search/providers returns {providers: {books, booksCovers, podcasts}} of {value, text} entries: books is BookFinder.providers without audiobookcovers in source order; booksCovers is best, the 15 built-in providers, the custom book providers and all; podcasts is itunes followed by the custom podcast providers. Every authenticated user may read it; without a token it is 401.
exceptions: The catalogue is derived from the static BookFinder.providers list and the stored custom providers, so every branch is asserted offline; no provider host is contacted by this route.

invariants.contract: On the fixture state (no custom provider) GET /api/search/providers answers 200 for the admin with exactly books, booksCovers and podcasts: books is the 14 built-in book providers with their display names in list order, booksCovers is best, the 15 built-in providers including audiobookcovers, then all, and podcasts is only itunes. Without a token it is 401.

With one non-admin caller and stored custom providers, books keeps the 14 built-ins in order and appends both custom book providers; booksCovers starts with best, keeps the 15 built-ins in order, then the custom book providers, then all; podcasts is itunes plus the custom podcast provider only, so a custom provider appears only under its stored mediaType.
